items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the $4.92 cannot be assigned to sites, so site revenue is unsupported. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27: 4,892 calls and $890.42 cost, with 225 errors and 5 transient errors. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are incomplete, monthly budget limits are blank, and no learning threshold is defined. The pilot’s 70 treatment outputs versus 44 controls is operational activity, not financial or causal lift. Continue only the existing reconciliation and evidence work; retain all growth and implementation items as deferred backlog.

Minimum finance evidence before reconsidering growth: period-aligned attributable revenue by site, content, and tracking ID; a reconciled AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment cost ledger; approved budget ceilings; and a defined learning outcome with a maximum cost-to-learn. Preserve provider aggregate rows as unattributed and do not treat site-attributed $0 as proof of zero performance.
